claim: Check the write extent of every dispatch entry, including ones only one figure kind uses: the boss spider's four-wide leftward entries lost a column until their E-3 offset was fixed.

evidence.text: Dispatch entries 59906/59951/59996/60041 (4-wide leftward, write E-3) are used by the boss spider only; an earlier build had the spider column missing, the fix ran on hardware (runs, better).
evidence.quote: leftward entries are used by the boss spider (Insect Island round 4) only.
